name: personal-health-agent
description: A local-first personal health management agent for logging blood pressure, labs, exercise, reminders, and weekly or monthly trends.

interface.shortDescription: Log health data and review trends
interface.longDescription: Collects local personal health logs such as blood pressure, blood lab markers, exercise, and body metrics. Produces safety-bounded analysis, reminders, and weekly or monthly ASCII trend reports for clinician-ready discussion.
defaultPrompt: Import my latest blood test markers.
Create this week's health trend report.
